# `never-mutated-var`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: semantic · Profile: none · Default: error · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a local `var` whose binding and reachable mutable aliases are never
mutated.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`const` communicates the actual invariant, prevents accidental later mutation,
and gives readers a smaller state space to reason about.

## When it fires

It applies to function and test locals after conservative alias, pointer,
cleanup, capture, and mutation checks.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
pub fn main() void {
    var count: u32 = 3;
    _ = count;
}
```
